lines.369680624961269760: I'm looking for a motel called the Crimson Bear. Do you know where that is?
lines.369680624961269761: That's just through the tunnel up the road. You can't miss it.
lines.369680624961269762: But you should really consider getting out of here while you still can. There could be flash floods, mudslides, you name it.
lines.369680624965464064: Don’t want to have to pull you out of a flooded car if I can help it.
lines.369680624965464065: I won’t cause you any trouble. Just trying to do my job.
lines.369680624965464066: Well, best of luck out there. Have a good one.
lines.369680624990629889: Do us all a favor, okay buddy?
lines.369680624999018496: Go home, draw a hot bath, and slit your fucking wrists.
lines.369680624999018499: You have a nice night now.
lines.369680625003212801: No. I was attacked. There’s something horrible happening in this town.
lines.369680625007407104: I… I don’t know how to describe it. It’s going to sound insane.
lines.369680625007407108: Never mind. Forget I said anything.
lines.369680625007407109: You sure? Do I have to worry about you?
lines.369680625007407110: No, I’m fine. Probably just tired.
lines.369680625007407111: You're not going crazy on me, are you, detective? Sounds to me like you need to slow down.
lines.369680625015795712: Sounds to me like you should have listened to my advice and gotten the hell out of town.
lines.369680625015795714: Just take it nice and slow.
lines.369680625015795717: This is a restricted frequency. Who’s out there?
lines.369680625024184320: Is this the deputy I saw on the ferry over?
lines.369680625024184321: Detective Walker. Still in one piece huh? Why haven't you left yet?
lines.369680625024184322: I’m still looking for Eddie Velvet. I'm following up on some leads that took me over to Riverside.
lines.369680625024184323: You don't need to look any further detective. I think I've got what you want.
lines.369680625024184324: Really? That's... You got him booked already? Why didn't you say so before?
lines.369680625028378624: Oh... Must have slipped my mind. Probably best you just come on over, get this all sorted out.
lines.369680625028378625: The code for the front door is: 17 15
lines.369680625057738752: Roberts, what are you doing in there? Where's Eddie?
lines.369680625057738753: Bad news, detective. Eddie’s not here.
lines.369680625057738754: What do you mean he’s not here? You said you had him booked.
lines.369680625057738755: I didn't say shit about having Eddie Locked up. That was you jumping to conclusions.
